description: Surface the recyclebin in the dashboard and make reindex layout-aware. Add a Trash view (/dashboard?view=trash) listing duplicates with the original they collide with, plus two POST actions per item — Khôi phục (restore to photos/, collision-safe) and Xoá vĩnh viễn (delete file+row). Update reindex so walking photos/ yields is_trash=false rows and walking recyclebin/ yields is_trash=true rows, deriving taken_at from file mtime, without crashing on old flat-layout files. Depends on FEAT-001 (ListTrash/GetByID/DeletePhoto*/SetTrashState, IsTrash/DupOf) and is independent of FEAT-002 (it does not touch the upload handlers), but is ordered last so it integrates on top of the finished data+upload layers.
steps: internal/dashboard/dashboard.go: extend viewItem with `IsTrash bool` and `DupInfo string` (the original photo's OriginalName or RelPath). In Index(), if r.URL.Query().Get("view")=="trash": load photos via d.pg.ListTrash(ctx, 2000) and for each resolve DupInfo (if p.DupOf != nil, d.pg.GetByID(ctx, *p.DupOf) -> OriginalName, else leave blank); set a Trash flag on the template data. Otherwise keep the existing ListByDate/ListAll branch (already trash-filtered in FEAT-001).
internal/dashboard/dashboard.go: compute a trash count for the header label (len(ListTrash) is fine, or a Count query). Add it to the template struct.

internal/dashboard/dashboard.go: update the inline html/template: add header nav with two links — "Ảnh" (/dashboard) and "Thùng rác (<count>)" (/dashboard?view=trash) — highlighting the active one. When in trash mode, render each cell with the thumbnail/icon + name + a line "trùng với {{.DupInfo}}" and TWO POST forms: Khôi phục -> action "/trash/restore", Xoá vĩnh viễn -> action "/trash/delete", each with a hidden input name="rel" value="{{.RelPath}}". Keep the existing non-trash grid markup unchanged. Keep Vietnamese UI text.

internal/dashboard/dashboard.go: add TrashDelete(w,r http) — require POST, r.ParseForm, rel := r.FormValue("rel"); reject if rel does not start with "recyclebin/" (http 400); d.store.Remove(rel) then d.pg.DeletePhotoByRelPath(ctx, rel); on success http.Redirect 303 to /dashboard?view=trash. Log errors in Vietnamese via d.logger.

internal/dashboard/dashboard.go: add TrashRestore(w,r http) — require POST, rel from form, must start with "recyclebin/"; derive baseName via path.Base(rel); open the file through d.store.Open(rel); StageTemp it (to reuse collision-safe finalize) OR add/use a storage helper MoveCollisionSafe(srcRel, destDir string, mtime time.Time) (*Result,error) that renames recyclebin/<yyyymm>/<f> to photos/<yyyymm>/ collision-safe reusing collisionSafeName; prefer the storage helper to avoid re-reading. After the move succeeds, d.store.Remove(old rel) if not already renamed, then d.pg.SetTrashState(oldRel, newRel, false, nil) to flip is_trash=false, dup_of=NULL and update rel_path; redirect 303 to /dashboard?view=trash. File move is the source of truth; DB is updated to match.

internal/storage/storage.go (if the move helper is chosen): add MoveCollisionSafe(srcRel, destDir string, mtime time.Time) (*Result, error) that stats the source to get its yyyymm (prefer keeping the existing <yyyymm> segment from srcRel so the date is preserved), hashes it only if needed for collisionSafeName, computes a collision-safe dest under <destDir>/<yyyymm>/, os.Rename across the two top-level dirs (same filesystem), returns *Result. Keep safeJoin on both ends.
internal/server/router.go: register `mux.HandleFunc("POST /trash/delete", dash.TrashDelete)` and `mux.HandleFunc("POST /trash/restore", dash.TrashRestore)` next to the existing dashboard routes.

internal/integrity/integrity.go: in walk(), also skip a ".staging" directory (like .uploads/.thumbs). In Reindex(), when building each store.Photo, inspect the first path segment of rel: "recyclebin" -> IsTrash=true; "photos" -> IsTrash=false; anything else (legacy flat "<user>/...") -> IsTrash=false. Derive taken_at from the file mtime as today (the <yyyymm> dir is informational). Leave DupOf nil for all reindexed rows. Pass IsTrash into UpsertPhoto. Add a short Vietnamese comment noting: dup_of cannot be reconstructed from disk (left NULL), and old flat-layout files are indexed as non-trash with no automatic migration in this change.
cmd/reindex/main.go: no logic change expected (it calls integrity.Reindex); only touch if a compile error surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: go build ./... and go vet ./... both pass.

GET /dashboard shows only non-trash items; GET /dashboard?view=trash lists is_trash=true items, each showing the name and "trùng với <original>" plus Khôi phục and Xoá vĩnh viễn POST buttons; the header shows a "Thùng rác (<count>)" tab.

POST /trash/delete removes the recyclebin file from disk AND its DB row; POST /trash/restore moves the file from recyclebin/<yyyymm>/ to photos/<yyyymm>/ collision-safe and sets is_trash=false, dup_of=NULL. Both reject a rel that is not under recyclebin/ and use 303 redirect.

reindex produces is_trash=false rows for files under photos/, is_trash=true rows for files under recyclebin/, derives taken_at from mtime, and does not crash when old flat-layout files or an empty/new layout are present.
verification: Runtime (best-effort, needs throwaway Postgres): with a temp APP_DATA_DIR seeded by FEAT-002's dedup smoke (or by hand-creating photos/<yyyymm>/a.jpg and recyclebin/<yyyymm>/a.jpg), start the server and confirm GET /dashboard?view=trash lists the trash item; POST /trash/restore then /trash/delete behave as specified; then run `go run ./cmd/reindex -env <tmp.env>` and confirm photos->non-trash and recyclebin->trash rows with no crash. Clean up temp dir + container.
findings:
SURFACED the recyclebin in the dashboard and made reindex layout-aware. No new deps.

internal/dashboard/dashboard.go:
- viewItem gained IsTrash bool + DupInfo string.
- Index() now reads ?view=trash. It always calls d.pg.ListTrash(ctx, 2000) once (used both for the header count AND, in trash mode, the grid). In trash mode each item resolves DupInfo: if p.DupOf != nil -> d.pg.GetByID(ctx,*p.DupOf) -> OriginalName (falls back to RelPath, blank if original missing). Non-trash mode keeps the existing ListByDate/ListAll branch (already is_trash=false filtered in FEAT-001). Template data struct gained Trash bool + TrashCount int.
- Inline html/template: added <nav> with two links — "Ảnh" (/dashboard) and "Thùng rác (<count>)" (/dashboard?view=trash) — highlighting the active one via .active. The date filter form is hidden in trash mode. Trash cells render thumbnail/icon + name + sub + a line "trùng với {{.DupInfo}}" (shows "(không rõ bản gốc)" when blank) and TWO POST forms with hidden rel: Khôi phục -> /trash/restore, Xoá vĩnh viễn -> /trash/delete. Non-trash grid markup unchanged. Empty-state text branches on Trash.
- TrashDelete (POST /trash/delete): ParseForm, rel must start with "recyclebin/" (else 400). d.store.Remove(rel) (500 on error) then d.pg.DeletePhotoByRelPath(ctx, rel) (logged on error). Vietnamese INFO log, 303 redirect to /dashboard?view=trash.
- TrashRestore (POST /trash/restore): ParseForm, rel must start with "recyclebin/" (else 400). Reads mtime via d.store.Stat(rel) to preserve the original date, then d.store.MoveCollisionSafe(rel, "photos", mtime) (500 on error). On success d.pg.SetTrashState(ctx, rel, res.RelPath, false, nil) flips is_trash=false/dup_of=NULL and updates rel_path. File move is the source of truth; DB follows. Vietnamese INFO log, 303 redirect.

internal/storage/storage.go:
- Added MoveCollisionSafe(srcRel, destDir string, mtime time.Time) (*Result, error): preserves the <yyyymm> segment parsed from srcRel (yyyymmFromRel) when present, else yyyymmFromTime(mtime); hashes the source (hashFileAt) so collisionSafeName can compare content on name clashes; MkdirAll dest; os.Rename across top-level dirs (same FS); idempotent if an identical file already exists at dest (removes source, no overwrite); os.Chtimes(mtime); returns *Result{RelPath,AbsPath,Size,SHA256}. safeJoin guards both src and dest. Added helpers yyyymmFromRel (2nd path segment, 6 digits) and hashFileAt.

internal/server/router.go: registered mux.HandleFunc("POST /trash/delete", dash.TrashDelete) and ("POST /trash/restore", dash.TrashRestore) next to the dashboard routes.

internal/integrity/integrity.go: walk() now also SkipDir on ".staging" (alongside .uploads/.thumbs). Reindex() derives IsTrash from the top-level dir via new topLevelDir(rel) helper: "recyclebin" -> true, "photos"/legacy flat "<user>/..." -> false; passes IsTrash into UpsertPhoto; taken_at still from file mtime; DupOf left nil. Added a Vietnamese comment noting dup_of cannot be reconstructed from disk (left NULL) and old flat-layout files are indexed as non-trash with no automatic migration. cmd/reindex/main.go unchanged (no compile error).

VERIFICATION: go build ./... + go vet ./... pass from the worktree. go test ./internal/storage/... ./internal/store/... ./internal/dashboard/... ./internal/integrity/... passes. Reindex layout check: ran a throwaway smoke (temp dir with photos/202303/a.jpg, recyclebin/202303/a.jpg, me/Photos/legacy.heic, plus .staging/.uploads/.thumbs) through integrity.Reindex with a nil-safe empty-DSN Postgres — indexed exactly 3 files (the three skip-dirs excluded), no crash on the legacy flat file, and topLevelDir-based is_trash derivation correct (recyclebin=true, photos/legacy=false). Harness removed after the run. Full HTTP + real-Postgres smoke not run: no throwaway Postgres/Redis in the sandbox (as anticipated by context.json).
